title: User acceptance testing (UAT) and the client’s role

videos.script: A product can pass every test the team wrote and still be the wrong product. {{wrong}} The people who notice are the ones who will use it. {{users}} User acceptance testing gives them the decision. The client sits down with the build and does real work with it. {{session}} Before that, you agree on what acceptable means, and you write it as acceptance criteria. Given a student booking two tickets. When she books. Then the total is half. {{criteria}} In this lesson the theatre's manager spends an afternoon with boxoffice 1.1. {{afternoon}} She meets a defect the team already knew, and gives it a cost in her own words. She finds a requirement that is right on paper and wrong at the counter. {{findings}} Then she decides. The release is accepted, accepted with conditions, or sent back. {{decide}} That decision is hers, not yours. Your job is to make sure she takes it knowing everything you know. {{yours}}
